The '''Houk Syndicate''' was an [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal syndicate operating on [[Voss]]. Their [[Houk Syndicate Lair|lair]] in the [[Old Paths]] was assaulted by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
